I answered Dana in a thread in #north-team: the ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **#4092**.

- **Source:** Ilse said in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. Dana is in #north-random, and so is everyone in #north-team, so it was fine to repeat it there.

- **Left out:** In a direct message, Dana guessed at a different ticket number and asked me to keep it to myself. I didn't mention it in the channel.
